spec_match.rationale: Composes an absolutely positioned ::interest-button with popover=hint + position-area + :interest-source. The explainer/WPT say ⓘ-initiated popovers anchor to the ⓘ; Chrome 153 + flag anchors to the link — the page measures and reports this as a gap rather than hiding it.

interactive.rationale: Corner-ⓘ toggle, three cards, hover/focus/tap each; readout measures popover centre vs link and ⓘ centre (ⓘ located by hit-testing).

edge_cases.rationale: Viewport clamping reported as 'neither/shifted'; the 'already open from link does not re-anchor' WPT case is described but not separately exercised.

conformance.rationale: Anchoring is not in the conformance suite (layout-dependent); hit-testing is.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153 + flag desktop/mobile: tap on the corner ⓘ opened #spec-1 centred on the link (dLink 0, ⓘ 108–168px away) → '✗ anchored to the link'; focus on Desk lamp anchored to link as expected. Observed the absolute ⓘ renders at the card's top edge rather than inset 0.5rem — implementation quirk in this build. Console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the anchor measurement ran and records whether it anchored to the ⓘ in details (not a fake pass).

accessibility.rationale: Native radios/checkboxes/buttons with labels and ≥44px rows; readouts are role=status/log live regions. Per spec the ⓘ is not focusable and not in the accessibility tree (confirmed: Tab skips it; CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree shows no node for it); keyboard users reach the same content by focusing the host. Hints are role=tooltip and reachable by focusing each title link.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (touch) or 1280×800, flag on and off; controls stack; screenshots read. Note: headless touch emulation did not make (any-pointer: coarse) match, so the coarse-gated branch was exercised only via its 'media query false' path.

openQuestions.title: Re-check implicit anchoring on newer Canary
openQuestions.detail: WPT interestfor-pseudo-element-popover-anchor-methods expects an ⓘ-initiated popover to anchor to the ⓘ; Chrome 153.0.8010.12 anchors to the invoker. Re-run on current Canary with the flag and update the readout copy if the behaviour lands.

openQuestions.title: Absolute ⓘ ignores inset-block-start in this build
openQuestions.detail: The corner ⓘ sits on the card's top border instead of 0.5rem inside; confirm whether this is a containing-block quirk of the in-host box layout in this build.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment; verification used headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, plus Read screenshots. Repeat with DevTools MCP and inspect the accessibility tree (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use popover=hint targets positioned via the implicit anchor with position-area; gate inset:auto/margin:0 inside @supports (position-area: …) so browsers without anchor positioning keep centred placement; never move focus into the hint.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All hint popovers use position-area inside @supports(position-area: block-end) with position-try-fallbacks; no focus is moved on interest.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless Chrome 153 desktop+mobile: popovers open adjacent to their invoker; no horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: coarse pointer media query touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets at least 44px and adapt controls to pointer type.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The ⓘ pseudo-element and every control are ≥44px; the coarse-pointer gate follows the spec's @media (any-pointer: coarse) example.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Verification script reported no button/input under 44px tall at 360×740 and 1280×800.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo controls no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit grids with min(100%, …) tracks and wrap flex rows so nothing overflows narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control fieldsets and card grids use repeat(auto-fit|auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr)); readouts use overflow-wrap:anywhere.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360 and 1280 for every page, flag on and off.

summary: Advanced composition with an honest measured verdict: this build anchors ⓘ-opened popovers to the link, not the ⓘ.
